title: Nasty Juice Slow Blow 50/50 10ml E-Liquid
description: Slow Blow e-liquid by Nasty Juice is a deliciously complex, sweet and refreshing fruit soda with incredible character. Tangy, ripe pineapple dominates the inhale followed by the zesty edge of lime and the cool tickle of soda, all finished to perfection with a refreshing layer of mint on the exhale. This e-liquid from Nasty Juice offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing immaculate flavour and rich, satisfying clouds. This e-liquid is versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits .
